To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have successfully deployed and used the WLCG infrastructure at the JINR Tier-2 and Prague Tier-2 sites.
the JINR and the Prague Tier-2 sites have a common experience in the WLG grid infrastructure and the Czech Tier-2 is the first site to be connected to the JINR Tier-1 site in Russia.
the Tier2 site at JINR is fully integrated with the WLCG infrastructure and provides the necessary services for the data processing.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the grid infrastructure in the WLCC collaboration and its integration into the WLCG infrastructure.
the analysis of the current situation and the prospects for further development of grid technologies.
the analysis of the WLCGs performance and the development of tools for monitoring and analysis of the grid systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the collaboration of the JINR and Prague Tier2 site was very productive.
this experience has been very useful and beneficial to both sides.
the collaboration of the JINR and Czech colleagues is very productive and fruitful.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we are ready to provide the WLCG infrastructure with Tier2 sites with the following features: • 1.6 PFlops peak performance • 2.2 PB storage (2.1 PB usable) • 100 TB of tape storage (100 TB usable) • 1.5 PB of disk storage for data analysis • 2.4 PB of disk storage in the near-line storage • ~100 TB/day of data throughput • ~1.6 PFLOPS/day of computing power
we are able to provide a stable and reliable grid infrastructure for the LHC experiments and the WLCG project.
the Tier-2 sites of Dubna and Prague have been successfully integrated into the global WLCG grid and provide a reliable and stable operation of the grid infrastructure for the LHC experiments.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cooperation between the sites is very important in the field of development of modern grid infrastructure and in the field of monitoring of the infrastructure.
the Tier2 site is a complex infrastructure with a lot of moving parts.
a common effort of two sites with different experience in the grid infrastructure development can lead to a significant increase in the efficiency of the grid infrastructure.
